name: codekami
description: Turn your coding journey into an anime-inspired RPG. Offline, private, no backend.

codekami.enableNotifications.description: Show notifications for streak milestones. Level-up and achievement reactions are controlled by the reaction settings below.

codekami.sessionStartXp.description: XP awarded once when a coding session starts.

codekami.fileSaveXp.description: XP awarded when a file is saved (subject to the cooldown below).

codekami.fileSaveCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between file-save XP rewards, per file.

codekami.showReactions.description: Show short anime-style reactions when you level up or unlock an achievement.

codekami.reactionMode.description: How reactions are shown: a notification popup, a transient status bar message, or both.

codekami.reactionCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between normal reactions. Level-up and achievement reactions always bypass this cooldown.

codekami.sessionInactivityMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before a coding session is considered ended.

codekami.showSessionSummary.description: Show a notification with a session summary when a coding session ends.

codekami.showCompanion.description: Show your CodeKami companion in the status bar. It reacts to level-ups, achievements, builds, tests, commits, and long sessions.

codekami.enableSounds.description: Play short sound effects for level-ups, achievements, builds, tests, commits, sessions, and streak milestones. Off by default. The first sound opens a 'CodeKami' panel at the bottom (next to Terminal) — click it once per VS Code session to allow audio (a one-time browser requirement); it stays enabled after that. You can also open it manually via 'CodeKami: Show Sound Panel'.

codekami.soundVolume.description: Sound effect volume, as a percentage.

codekami.soundCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between non-critical sound effects (build/test/commit/session). Level-up and achievement sounds always bypass this. Lower it if you build/test frequently and want a sound every time; raise it if repeated sounds get annoying.

codekami.showDailyMotivation.description: Show a short, original daily motivational message on the dashboard. The same message shows all day, chosen deterministically — no server or randomness involved.

codekami.focusXpPerMinute.description: XP earned per minute spent in a Focus Mode or Boss Battle session. No XP is earned if a session is abandoned.

codekami.debugMode.description: Log CodeKami activity (XP, level-ups, achievements, streaks, sessions) to the 'CodeKami' output channel. No source code or file names are logged.

scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
